title: Canada Trade Can Help US Cool Inflation, Poilievre Says
description:
Conservative Party of Canada Leader Pierre Poilievre discusses the state of trade and tariffs with the United States. He says Canada’s oil and mineral resources can help alleviate US inflation pressures, but the Trump administration needs to back off its tariff policies against its northern neighbor. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.”
